numericSemantics.state: Host supplies snapshots; consumed graph roots compute numerical decisions and next state. Rendering, IO and FP64 compatibility remain host operations.

state.native: Trip start time, origin floor/direction and room bindings stay FP64 host state; graph outputs drive cabin height, doors, display and boarding.
Door progress timeline, hinge transform and actor positions stay FP64 host state; leaf rotation uses the graph angle.
Shot key tables (sorted times and FP64 inverse spans) are built once per shot by the host; per-frame lookup is consumed from the graph.
